title: GOAT – Crystal Ice
description:
GOAT Crystal Ice #16 is delivered with a taste of Mint and Menthol. GOAT Crystal Ice comes with a nicotine level of 16,4mg/g (11,49mg/pouch).

The semi moist slimmed pouch immediately releases a fantastic flavor of Mint once you put it under your lip.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16,4

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,49

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Portions/Can: 20
